title: Brand Token Override Schema
description: Schema for brand-specific semantic token overrides

components.description: Component-scoped token overrides. Keyed by PascalCase component name (matching the contract's directory name, e.g. 'Button', 'Badge'), then by the same nested path shape the component's own <Name>.tokens.json sidecar uses (e.g. components.Button.color.background.default). Compiles to a CSS custom property scoped to [data-brand="<id>"] .<cssPrefix> — the same --fsds-<cssPrefix>-<path> variable name the component's own sidecar declares, so it overrides that one component in that one brand without touching the shared semantic default other components consume. Requires the token build's @layer components wrapping (see docs/architecture/tokens-architecture.md) to actually win the cascade; do not use for values every component sharing that semantic path should also pick up — use the top-level color/shape/spacing/motion/typography blocks for that.
